Politics · India

India begins voter roll revision process across multiple states

India has commenced a month-long special intensive revision of electoral rolls in various regions, including Delhi and Karnataka. Booth Level Officers (BLOs) will conduct door-to-door verification of voters. The process aims to update the voter list, with final lists expected to be published in October. In West Bengal, concerns have been raised about potential welfare benefit losses for millions due to voter deletions.
